title: Kenworth T909 custom FUPS Road Train Bullbar #15
description: Kenworth T909 FUPS 5 post hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar, 88 diameter pipe, Cow Catcher to base of Bullbar on extended uprights, 4 additional uprights to lower bar. Outer side contour plates. Reversable Long Vehicle/Road Train signs, Indicator repeaters and daytime running lights in outer uprights. Powder-coated tow pin plate. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification.
